routes.name_es: Docencia universitaria sin reconocimiento ni revalidación
routes.what_it_produces: No Chilean certificate or professional title. A Chilean university may assess the Ukrainian degrees itself and employ the holder for non-clinical teaching or research. It does not authorize diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions or other clinical practice.
routes.who_runs_it: The employing Chilean university or medical faculty.
routes.why_not: NONE. National recognition is not legally mandatory for university teaching, although an employer may require it and immigration permission is separate.
routes.online_portal_url: NONE — apply through each university's recruitment system.
routes.account_creation: Whatever the employer requires. After a job offer, a foreign applicant can create a SERMIG account without ClaveÚnica for the separate residence application.
steps: Apply directly to medical faculties with the Ukrainian MD, Candidate of Medical Sciences degree, academic record and publications.
Provide apostilled and translated documents if requested by the employer.

Keep teaching duties non-clinical unless a medical-practice route below has been completed. Article 113 defines unauthorized diagnosis or treatment as illegal: https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/Navegar?idNorma=5595&idParte=9407791.
After obtaining a contract or qualifying offer, apply separately for permission to work/reside in Chile.
routes.cost: No government degree-recognition fee. Translation, apostille, immigration and employer-specific costs remain.
routes.evidence_quote: “No se requiere autorización para ejercer la docencia ... para desempeñarse en las Universidades”
routes.history_note: This is a longstanding higher-education teaching exception, not an online recognition system.

routes.name_es: Revalidación del título de Médico Cirujano ante la Universidad de Chile
routes.what_it_produces: A Universidad de Chile certificate/diploma declaring equivalence between the Ukrainian medical qualification and the Chilean professional title Médico Cirujano. This is the conventional professional-title route. EUNACOM remains separately necessary for the public-sector, municipal, FONASA and other uses governed by Law 20.261.
routes.who_runs_it: Oficina de Revalidación y Reconocimiento, Universidad de Chile, under the University's own statute.
routes.why_not: NONE. A foreign passport is accepted; Chilean residence, RUT and ClaveÚnica are not required to create the UChile account or begin uploading documents.
routes.account_creation: Create Cuenta UChile at https://cuenta.uchile.cl/ using the foreign passport and email. No RUT or ClaveÚnica is required for this route.
steps: Create or recover Cuenta UChile.
Enter Ucampus and select “Revalidación de título”.
Complete the three online stages and upload the diploma, transcript, curriculum, course programmes, passport, professional habilitation and translations in PDF.
Pay the 2 UTM intake fee in Chilean pesos from a Chilean bank account.
After document review, book the original-document verification appointment; an apostilled/notarized power permits a representative to attend.
Pay 3 UTM for curricular assessment.
Complete any examinations, placements or additional subjects imposed by the Faculty of Medicine.
Receive approval, refusal or a requirement-completion decision.
routes.cost: 2 UTM intake plus 3 UTM curricular assessment. Academic requirements and final documents can add costs.
routes.duration: Universidad de Chile states a minimum of six months; its academic unit has 60 business days for the curricular study after payment, excluding intake, corrections and additional requirements.
routes.evidence_quote: “Crear o recuperar Cuenta Uchile ... Acceder con dicha cuenta en la Plataforma Ucampus ... arancel de ingreso (2 UTM) ... estudio curricular (3 UTM)”
routes.history_note: This is almost certainly the remembered account-based website. A 2019 guide used email/Google Drive—“Enviar los documentos en formato digital a nuestro correo electrónico”—rather than a separate national portal: https://weblex.derecho.uchile.cl/FTP/comunicaciones/documentos/Sec_estudio/13_Documento_informativo_revalidante_2019.pdf. Cuenta UChile/Ucampus became mandatory in December 2021. The base Ucampus endpoint intermittently returned an outage page during this check, but the current official instructions and login page remain published.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento de grado académico ante la Universidad de Chile
routes.what_it_produces: A certificate assimilating an accepted foreign academic degree to a Chilean Licenciado, Magíster or Doctor degree. It could make the Ukrainian Candidate of Medical Sciences credential easier to use in academic hiring, but it neither revalidates the MD nor authorizes medical practice.
routes.who_runs_it: Oficina de Revalidación y Reconocimiento, Universidad de Chile.
routes.why_not: The route accepts Ukrainians, but Universidad de Chile must decide whether the конкретний Candidate of Medical Sciences degree is academically assimilable to Licenciado, Magíster or Doctor; there is no automatic Candidate-of-Sciences-to-Doctor rule.
routes.account_creation: Cuenta UChile created with foreign passport and email at https://cuenta.uchile.cl/.
steps: Create Cuenta UChile and select the recognition procedure in Ucampus.
Upload the academic-degree diploma, transcript, study plan, thesis or equivalent, passport, apostilles and Spanish translations.
Pay the intake and academic-study fees.
Attend or appoint a representative for original-document verification.
Await the academic equivalence decision.
routes.cost: The published UChile schedule is 2 UTM for intake and 3 UTM for academic study, with possible additional costs.
routes.duration: Minimum six months according to Universidad de Chile; longer if corrections or additional academic requirements arise.
routes.evidence_quote: “Reconocimiento: Certificación del título o grado extranjero, mediante la asimilación con el respectivo grado académico chileno”
routes.history_note: The same Cuenta UChile/Ucampus workflow has applied to all applicants since December 2021. It is not a separate PhD-recognition website.

routes.name_es: Revalidación profesional bajo el Decreto Supremo N.º 174/2024 por una universidad estatal habilitada
routes.what_it_produces: A revalidation certificate establishing equivalence to a Chilean professional title. For medicine, health-sector requirements still govern the particular work that may be performed; EUNACOM is required for the posts and benefits specified by Law 20.261.
routes.who_runs_it: An eligible state university through its Unidad Coordinadora and academic unit; Universidad de Chile professional-title revalidation remains under its separate statute.
routes.why_not: Nationality is not a bar. The applicant must find an eligible state university that teaches accredited medicine, has a graduating cohort and is actually accepting applications. No such university-specific public applicant portal was found during this search.
routes.online_portal_url: NONE — no unified MINEDUC portal and no verified university applicant URL was found as of 6 September 2026.
routes.account_creation: Institution-specific. Decreto 174 expressly accepts a passport, national identity document or travel document; it does not require RUT or ClaveÚnica.
steps: Identify an eligible state university offering accredited medicine.
File with that university's Unidad Coordinadora, not with MINEDUC.
Provide apostilled diploma, grades, curriculum, professional habilitation, passport and Spanish translations.
Pass curricular review and, if imposed, examinations, final-degree activities, placements or additional subjects.
Receive the university's decision and certificate.
routes.cost: Decreto Exento 384/2026 establishes national stage ceilings of 2, 3, 15 and 20 UTM, depending on the stage actually required: https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/Navegar?idNorma=1226114&idVersion=2026-08-17.
routes.duration: The regulation gives the coordinating unit 30 business days to request the academic report and the academic unit 45 business days for study. Additional curricular requirements may be programmed across up to three academic semesters, with generally up to two years for the applicant to complete them.
routes.evidence_quote: “Solo las universidades del Estado con un mínimo de acreditación institucional de nivel avanzado de cinco años tendrán la atribución de ... revalidar títulos profesionales”
routes.history_note: Legally live since 17 August 2026. The applicant-facing implementation remains immature: the regulation says each institution must publish its procedure, but no public medicine intake page was found.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento de grado académico bajo el Decreto Supremo N.º 174/2024
routes.what_it_produces: A certificate accepting the foreign degree and, for differently named academic degrees, stating assimilation to Licenciado, Magíster or Doctor. It may support an academic career but does not authorize medicine.
routes.who_runs_it: An eligible state university with an appropriate academic field, graduating cohort and required accreditation.
routes.why_not: Open irrespective of nationality, but success depends on institutional and degree equivalence. No authoritative predetermined Chilean equivalence for the Ukrainian Candidate of Medical Sciences was found.
routes.online_portal_url: NONE — apply to the selected university's Unidad Coordinadora; no common public platform was found.
steps: Select an eligible state university with an appropriate medicine or biomedical programme.
Submit the degree, transcript, programme, thesis or thesis link, passport, apostilles and translations.
Undergo academic assessment.
Receive recognition, refusal or a request for additional material.
routes.cost: Subject to Decreto Exento 384/2026 stage ceilings of 2, 3, 15 and 20 UTM where applicable.
routes.duration: At least the statutory intake and 45-business-day academic-assessment stages; corrections and further requirements can extend it.
routes.evidence_quote: “solo se les reconocerá si son asimilables ... a un grado de licenciado, magíster o doctor”
routes.history_note: New nationwide state-university authority effective 17 August 2026; no centralized applicant account accompanies it.

routes.name_es: Convalidación de actividades curriculares y terminación de una carrera chilena
routes.what_it_produces: Recognition of equivalence for individual foreign curricular activities. Convalidación alone does not recognize the Ukrainian MD; if admitted and the person completes the remaining Chilean medical programme, the end product is a new Chilean Médico Cirujano title.
routes.who_runs_it: Eligible institutions under Decreto 174; Universidad de Chile is also covered by that regulation for convalidación.
routes.why_not: Requires admission to a destination programme and acceptance of sufficient curricular equivalence. The remaining medical curriculum may still be substantial.
routes.online_portal_url: NONE — institution-specific admissions and convalidación process.
routes.account_creation: Institution-specific; passport is acceptable under Decreto 174.
steps: Obtain admission or acceptance from a Chilean medical programme.
Request convalidación with detailed syllabi, hours, credits, grades, apostilles and translations.
Complete every non-convalidated course, placement, internship and graduation requirement.
Receive the Chilean degree after completing the programme.
routes.cost: Decreto Exento 384/2026 controls recognition/convalidación stage fees; tuition and remaining programme costs are separate and potentially much larger.
routes.duration: Depends on the number of accepted activities and the remaining Chilean curriculum.
routes.evidence_quote: “se determina la equivalencia entre los contenidos temáticos y las competencias adquiridas en actividades curriculares”
routes.history_note: This is a credit-transfer route, not a direct recognition or revalidation certificate.

routes.what_it_produces: After passing the complete EUNACOM, the foreign Médico Cirujano title is automatically revalidated. It also satisfies the EUNACOM requirement for the public/municipal posts, FONASA libre elección and other uses specified by Law 20.261.
routes.who_runs_it: ASOFAMECH/EUNACOM under the statutory national examination system.
routes.why_not: NONE as to nationality. The present obstacle is logistical: first-time foreign graduates must enrol through the in-person procedure and the examinations are conducted in Chile.
routes.online_portal_url: First-time applicant: NONE for final enrolment; instructions and payment/reservation links are at https://www.eunacom.cl/inscripcion/inscripcion.html. The actual application at https://inscripcion.eunacom.cl/ is for previous examinees and EUNACOM-SP after passing ST.
routes.account_creation: Passport is accepted. No RUT or ClaveÚnica is stated for first-time foreign graduates.
steps: Prepare the apostilled foreign medical diploma, transcript/other required documents, passport and translations.
Pay CLP 310,000 online for EUNACOM-ST.
Reserve an enrolment appointment.
Attend the enrolment appointment or send a third party with simple authorization.
Sit and pass EUNACOM-ST in Chile.
Enrol for and pass the required EUNACOM-SP stages in Chile.
routes.cost: CLP 310,000 for ST and CLP 720,000 for four SP stages: CLP 1,030,000 for a full first attempt, excluding travel, documents and repeats.
routes.duration: No single guaranteed duration. It depends on examination dates and completion of the practical stages.
routes.evidence_quote: “habrá revalidado automáticamente su título profesional de médico cirujano”
routes.history_note: The exact URL https://www.eunacom.cl/inscripcion/ is reachable but is a legacy news/archive page with 2021–2022 material. The current instructions are at /inscripcion/inscripcion.html, and the JavaScript application is inscripcion.eunacom.cl.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento o registro por tratado bilateral ante MINREL
routes.what_it_produces: An electronically signed MINREL recognition/registration certificate for an eligible treaty-country title. For medicine, EUNACOM remains a separate requirement for the statutory public/FONASA uses.
routes.who_runs_it: Departamento de Registro y Reconocimiento de Títulos, Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores.
routes.why_not: The live bilateral list is Brazil, Peru and Uruguay. Ukraine is not listed and has no applicable recognition treaty.
routes.account_creation: No persistent account. The applicant identifies with RUT, DNI or passport and returns using a unique validation code emailed by the platform.
steps: Create a request and upload the apostilled/legalized title, complete transcript, proof of the university's legal existence and passport.
Wait for administrative review and the appointment email.
Reserve an interview and present originals plus authorized copies.
Download the electronically signed PDF certificate from the platform.
routes.cost: Free. ChileAtiende states “El trámite no tiene costo”: https://www.chileatiende.gob.cl/fichas/2461/1/pdf.
routes.duration: No current official maximum was found.
routes.history_note: The same online system has been mandatory since 5 December 2016. Ecuador moved away from the older MINREL treaty channel in 2017; Colombia ceased to use MINREL on 1 May 2022; Guatemala ceased on 1 January 2025. These changes explain stale older guidance but do not indicate a replaced account system.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento MINREL bajo la Convención de México con examen general de salud
routes.what_it_produces: A MINREL recognition/registration certificate after the required general examination for health-related titles from an eligible Convention state. It is distinct from EUNACOM.
routes.who_runs_it: MINREL receives the application and refers the health-title examination to Universidad de Chile.
routes.why_not: The live Convention list is Bolivia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua and Peru. Ukraine is not a party to this Chilean recognition route.
routes.account_creation: Passport or other accepted identifier plus an emailed validation code; no persistent account.
steps: File and upload through the MINREL portal.
MINREL reviews and forwards the health-title case to Universidad de Chile.
Pass the required general examination.
Complete the MINREL interview/original-document stage.
Download the certificate.
routes.cost: MINREL filing is free; a current authoritative fee for the Universidad de Chile Convention examination was not found.
routes.duration: Not published as a single current period.
routes.evidence_quote: “deben rendir previamente un examen general ... los remite a la Universidad de Chile”
routes.history_note: This is part of the continuing MINREL platform, not an old or replacement account system.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento por convenio administrado por MINEDUC
routes.what_it_produces: An official MINEDUC recognition of an eligible degree from Argentina, Spain, the United Kingdom or Northern Ireland. It does not by itself replace EUNACOM requirements attached to particular medical work.
routes.who_runs_it: Unidad de Reconocimiento de Títulos, Subsecretaría de Educación Superior/MINEDUC.
routes.why_not: Ukraine is not covered. The current MINEDUC page lists only Argentina, Spain, the United Kingdom and Northern Ireland.
routes.online_portal_url: NONE — current instructions use country-specific email addresses rather than a filing account: titulos.argentina@mineduc.cl, titulos.espana@mineduc.cl and titulos.uk@mineduc.cl.
routes.account_creation: None. Contact begins by email; an Ayuda Mineduc account is not the application mechanism.
steps: Confirm that the title and institution meet the applicable treaty requirements.
Prepare the country-specific documents.
Email the relevant MINEDUC address for instructions and submission.
Complete any original-document or verification requests.
Receive MINEDUC's recognition decision.
routes.cost: No current fee statement was found on the live MINEDUC guidance.
routes.duration: No current official turnaround was found.
routes.evidence_quote: “títulos ... obtenidos ... Argentina, España y Reino Unido e Irlanda del Norte”
routes.history_note: Ecuador's route was suspended indefinitely from 27 September 2025; the same current page says “se encuentra suspendido indefinidamente” and directs new Ecuador cases to Universidad de Chile. Older guidance used an in-person appointment; COVID-era guidance switched to email. No separate MINEDUC recognition-account platform was found.

routes.name_es: Certificación ordinaria de especialidad obtenida en el extranjero
routes.what_it_produces: A time-limited Chilean specialty certificate—CONACEM states ten years—after programme-equivalence review and examinations. Together with a base title already habilitated in Chile, it supports practice as a certified specialist.
routes.who_runs_it: An entity authorized by the Ministry of Health; CONACEM operates the documented foreign-training route.
routes.why_not: The doctor needs a formal, documentable rheumatology specialist programme/title—not merely an academic post—and normally a base medical title already habilitated in Chile. CONACEM's current online registration also requires a Chilean RUT.
routes.account_creation: Chilean RUT mandatory. The live form says only Chileans or foreigners possessing Chilean RUT may register.
steps: First obtain base medical habilitation through revalidation, treaty recognition or EUNACOM.
Obtain a Chilean RUT.
Register online with CONACEM.
Submit the official foreign specialty programme, completion evidence and specialist title, translated, apostilled/legalized and supported by recent practice evidence.
Obtain CONACEM's equivalence approval.
Pass the theoretical and practical examinations in Spanish.
Receive and register the specialty certification.
routes.cost: CLP 230,000 certification fee plus CLP 300,000 per written examination and CLP 450,000 per practical examination; minimum CLP 980,000 if one of each is passed.
routes.duration: Written examinations are scheduled at least twice yearly. After passing theory, the applicant normally has up to 18 months to finish the assessment.
routes.evidence_quote: “el postulante deberá rendir las evaluaciones correspondientes teóricas y prácticas”
routes.history_note: CONACEM's current requirements page was updated 26 November 2025; the application-fee page was updated 2 September 2025.

routes.name_es: Certificación de especialidad sin revalidación general bajo la Ley N.º 20.985
routes.what_it_produces: A specialty certificate that authorizes practice only in the certified specialty or subspecialty and only in Chile's public health sector. It does not create unrestricted general-practice or private-practice rights.
routes.who_runs_it: A Ministry of Health-authorized certifying entity; CONACEM publishes and operates this procedure.
routes.why_not: Potentially applicable if she holds qualifying formal rheumatology specialist training, but she cannot open CONACEM's current account without a Chilean RUT. Equivalence review and Spanish theoretical/practical examinations are required.
routes.account_creation: Chilean RUT mandatory; therefore unavailable to this person today from Ukraine.
steps: Obtain a Chilean RUT.
Register with CONACEM under Law 20.985.
Submit the foreign medical and specialty credentials, official programme, continuity-of-practice evidence, apostilles and translations.
Pass equivalence review and the same theoretical and practical examinations used for other candidates.
Receive a certificate expressly restricted to the specialty and public sector.
Have the resulting habilitation recorded through the health-provider registry process.
routes.cost: CONACEM's current minimum is CLP 980,000 if one written and one practical examination are passed, plus document and travel costs.
routes.duration: Dependent on committee review and examination scheduling; after theory, the normal maximum is 18 months to complete evaluation.
routes.evidence_quote: “el ejercicio de su profesión quedará limitado ... sólo para el sector público”
routes.history_note: The permanent Law 20.985 route remains live. Do not confuse it with the separate COVID-era temporary extensions under Laws 21.274/21.502, which have expired and were not online degree-recognition systems.

routes.name_es: Autorización excepcional para ejercer en barcos, islas o lugares apartados
routes.what_it_produces: A geographically and administratively limited authorization to work as a doctor in a ship, island or remote place. It is not national revalidation and does not create unrestricted practice rights.
routes.who_runs_it: The relevant SEREMI de Salud under the successor administration of Article 112 of the Código Sanitario.
routes.why_not: It is discretionary, restricted to specified remote settings and normally requires a concrete service need or position. A current applicant portal and complete current procedure were not found.
routes.account_creation: Unknown; no current national online account was found for this authorization.
steps: Secure a remote-location public-service need or prospective appointment.
Contact the territorially competent SEREMI de Salud.
Present the foreign professional title and any documents the SEREMI requires.
Obtain express authorization before performing clinical acts.
routes.cost: Not found in current official online guidance.
routes.evidence_quote: “podrán desempeñarse como médicos ... en barcos, islas o lugares apartados ... personas que acreditaren título profesional otorgado en el extranjero”
routes.history_note: Superintendencia guidance calls this “Autorización transitoria otorgada por Seremis de Salud”: https://www.superdesalud.gob.cl/difusion/665/articles-17530_recurso_1.pdf. No public nationwide filing platform was identified.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE authentication service, not an independent recognition authority. It provides the login used by Ucampus. A Ukrainian may create/use it with a foreign passport; recovery states: “ingresa tu RUT o número pasaporte extranjero” (https://cuenta.uchile.cl/recovery/identification).
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Universidad de Chile users, including foreign revalidation/recognition applicants.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE information and redirect page for the MINREL treaty route, not a filing platform. Its PDF says “La solicitud de reconocimiento de título se realiza a través de un formulario en línea”: https://www.chileatiende.gob.cl/fichas/2461/1/pdf. A Ukrainian may read it but is not eligible for the underlying treaty route. Its country information should not override the live MINREL list.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: People checking whether their treaty-country title can be recognized by MINREL.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE downstream application to add an already habilitated title or specialty to the Registro Nacional de Prestadores Individuales de Salud. It is not recognition: the form asks for “Entidad que otorgó el reconocimiento, revalidación o habilitación” and requires “RUN”. The Ukrainian doctor cannot use it now without RUN and prior habilitation.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Health professionals who already possess a Chilean title, recognition, revalidation or other habilitation.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: Reachable but historically stale EUNACOM archive/landing page, not the current application form; it still displays “Próximo EUNACOM se rendirá en enero 2023”. Current instructions are https://www.eunacom.cl/inscripcion/inscripcion.html and the limited online application is https://inscripcion.eunacom.cl/.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: General EUNACOM information readers; it should not be used as a current registration calendar.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE directory of links, not a common application portal. It explicitly lists the three separate channels—MINEDUC treaty, MINREL and Universidad de Chile—under “Reconocimiento de estudios realizados en el extranjero”.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: People looking for the correct education-related authority or information page.

portals_that_are_not_routes.url: NONE — internal platform required by Article 8 of Decreto 174
portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: The Subsecretaría's centralized digital platform is an institution-facing duplicate-control system, not an applicant portal. Article 8 says “la Unidad deberá cargar una copia de la nómina a la plataforma digital de información centralizada”: https://nuevo.leychile.cl/servicios/Consulta/Exportar?exportar_con_notas_al_pie=True&exportar_con_notas_bcn=True&exportar_con_notas_originales=True&exportar_formato=pdf&hddResultadoExportar=1221526.2026-08-17.0.0%23&nombrearchivo=Decreto-174_17-FEB-2026&radioExportar=Normas.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: The coordinating units of participating Chilean higher-education institutions, not individual foreign graduates.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE Plataforma de Educación Superior institutional login. It supports benefits, admissions and SIES data: “facilitar el trabajo conjunto y colaborativo con las Instituciones de Educación Superior.” It does not accept recognition applications.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Authorized staff of Chilean higher-education institutions; not the Ukrainian applicant.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE admissions, benefits, income and employability information site. Its optional email account is used to save/download searches—“Para descargar esta búsqueda usted debe haber iniciado sesión o registrarse”—not to recognize a degree. The Ukrainian may register, but it has no recognition effect.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Prospective students and people researching Chilean programmes and labour outcomes.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE citizen-support account for questions, complaints and tracking support requests, not a degree-recognition application. The form identifies itself as “Portal de Atención Ciudadana” and requires “RUN”. The Ukrainian doctor cannot create this account in her present circumstances.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: People with a RUN contacting Ayuda Mineduc.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE certificate portal, but its “Reconocimiento de Estudios en el Extranjero” concerns school/basic-secondary study certificates. The page groups it with “Licencias de Educación Media, Certificados Anuales de Estudios”. It does not recognize university medical degrees.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: People obtaining Chilean school records, school-level foreign-study recognition certificates or records from closed Chilean institutions.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE Chilean state digital identity, not a recognition process. Current guidance says: “Para solicitar tu ClaveÚnica debes ... contar con tu cédula de identidad vigente”: https://www.chileatiende.gob.cl/fichas/11331-clave-unica. The overseas procedure is explicitly for Chileans and requires a valid Chilean identity card for video issuance. A Ukrainian abroad with no Chilean cédula/RUN cannot obtain it now.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: People holding a valid Chilean identity card, including qualifying resident foreigners; the special overseas channel is for Chileans abroad.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE MINREL service directory, but it currently offers only “Consultas, Reclamos MINREL” and “Registro electrónico de las y los Chilenos en el Exterior”. It is not the title-recognition filing platform.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: People submitting MINREL inquiries/complaints and Chileans registering abroad.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE public results/verification gateway, not an application. Universidad de Chile states: “Esta información es sólo referencial y no sustituye a los certificados oficiales”.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Applicants, employers and members of the public checking already approved UChile cases.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: MINREL certificate-validation function for a certificate already issued, not a recognition application. The main portal describes it as “Sistema de verificación de certificaciones de Reconocimiento y Registro de Títulos”.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Certificate holders and third parties verifying authenticity.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: LIVE immigration/work-residence route, not credential recognition. It may be the source of a separate remembered account: “debe realizarse desde el extranjero, ingresando con la cuenta creada por el postulante ... o con ClaveÚnica”. A Ukrainian can create the applicant account from abroad when she has the required employment basis.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Foreigners applying from abroad for temporary residence based on remunerated activity.

bottom_line: The remembered “create an account, then confirm/upload credentials” website was, with high confidence, Universidad de Chile’s Cuenta UChile → Ucampus revalidation workflow. The current Ucampus page literally places “Crear una Cuenta UChile” before completing the application and document review. MINREL is the secondary possibility, but MINREL does not create a persistent account: it creates a request and sends an email validation code, and Ukraine is ineligible. No separate national MINEDUC account-based foreign-degree recognition system was found, current or discontinued. Historically, UChile used email/Google Drive in 2019 and then made Cuenta UChile/Ucampus mandatory in December 2021; the older “Pasaporte UChile” name was an account-layer predecessor, not another recognition authority. MINREL’s own online form has continued since December 2016. MINEDUC treaty cases use email, and Decreto 174’s central Subsecretaría platform is internal to universities. For teaching, she may apply directly for non-clinical university posts without recognition, although academic recognition of the Candidate of Medical Sciences degree may help and work residence is separate. For general medical practice, EUNACOM is the clearest independent route because passing automatically revalidates the MD, but first-time enrolment and the examinations require Chile-based logistics. UChile revalidation can be started online now with a passport and no RUT; the new eligible-state-university route is legally live but no applicant intake page was found. For rheumatology, CONACEM is relevant only if she has formal specialist training/title: the permanent Law 20.985 route can authorize public-sector specialty-only practice without general revalidation, but CONACEM currently blocks account creation until she has a Chilean RUT.
unknowns: No public applicant portal or confirmed medicine intake page was found for any eligible state university operating under Decreto 174 as of 6 September 2026. Each university must publish its own procedure, so this may change quickly.
